answer: Weight each identity by its contribution to the trust graph minimum spanning tree, re-rooted every epoch at a seed the public beacon picks unpredictably. A genuinely useful agent sits as a load-bearing vertex whose removal fractures many real paths; a sybil clone attaches as a redundant leaf at the graph nadir, adding near-zero spanning weight however many you spawn. Because the beacon reseeds the root each round, an operator cannot precompute a tree that favors its swarm, so flooding buys no influence.
